env._REVENUECAT_comment: RevenueCat PUBLIC SDK keys (app.revenuecat.com > Project > API keys > App-specific). PUBLIC keys only — they can read offerings and post receipts, nothing else; the webhook secret is server-side (supabase secrets set REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET). EMPTY IS THE SAFE STATE: src/lib/iap derives isIapAvailable from this key, so blank means the paywall honestly reports the store cannot transact instead of rendering a Start-trial CTA that throws on tap. Paste the real keys before the next App Store submission or Guideline 2.1(b) fires again.
